title: Sciatic cuff · measured ENG and EMG
citation: Li, M., Elyahoodayan, S., Rezard, Q., Chen, J., Baldwin, A., Meng, E., & Song, D. (2025). Acute stimulation and recording of the rat sciatic nerve using a self-sizing and soft closing polymer cuff electrode (Version 1). SPARC. doi:10.26275/6fxa-8gef.
processing: pyABF reads native scaled samples; 50 ms unfiltered excerpts from three source ABF files. No averaging, baseline subtraction, artifact removal or downsampling. Alignment follows the authors’ positive 700 threshold convention on ADC0 and begins 0.6 ms before the first qualifying crossing.

provenance.subject: sub-20241014
provenance.channelMap: Authors’ Figure 3 notebook: zero-based channel2 ENG, channel1 EMG. ADC0 is used only for artifact alignment.
provenance.amplitudeUnits: ABF declares V, while authors’ notebook plots these same numbers as µV. Preserve values without conversion; display source units because this is a source metadata conflict.
provenance.pulseWidth: Published filenames/folder say 200ms; notebook and study protocol describe 200µs. Filename is retained; 200µs is labeled as documented, not inferred from filename.
provenance.timing: Artifact threshold crossing is observed; hardware stimulus-onset timestamps are not independently provided. Do not infer conduction latency from this marker.

sourceFiles.purpose: Channel identity and threshold alignment convention; code Figure 3 assigns zero-based ENG channel2 and EMG channel1 for sub-20241014.

limitations: Research polymer cuff stimulates; a separate commercial silicone cuff records ENG, and needle electrodes record EMG. This is related cuff research, not measurements from a named CWRU/FINE/LivaNova product.
Stimulation artifacts are retained; a large initial deflection is not automatically a neural response.
ABF and author-plot amplitude units conflict; values are displayed in source units, not calibrated µV.
The event marker is an artifact threshold crossing, not exact stimulus onset.
Three single events from one rat; this is not an averaged recruitment curve or a device prediction.
